text:
leo_cs: Heads-up: Novena (Julia) is cutting over in Brazil next week and asked for a regional peering (sa-east-1) + a short-term per-route rate increase for customer-facing search. Renewal in 5w and launch timing is a contract milestone.
tess_platform: Can you confirm whether they want IP allowlist or header-based gating? and which route(s) need the lift?
julia_novena: Hi! We prefer header-based gating (x-novena-team) so we don't manage IPs. Targets: /v1/search (primary) and /v1/assist (fallback). Baseline 120 rps, need 600 rps sustained for 48h then back to 150. Bursts up to ~1.2k for a few mins during migration waves.
ivan_enginfra: Header allowlist is fine. We'll add an ingress rule to require x-novena-team header value and enforce token check. Need the header value and CA cert for peering.
leo_cs: Julia please drop the header secret and cert. Also AE Karen flagged that if launch slips >48h renewal risk rises. We should capture perf goals (p50<180ms, p95<350ms) and token-cost estimate.
julia_novena: Header token: NVN-PRD-9aBc; CA cert uploaded to S3 path: s3://novena-shared/peering/ca.pem.
deploy-bot: Generated config draft:
```
ingress:
  region: sa-east-1
  header_allowlist:
    header_name: "x-novena-team"
    allowed_values: ["NVN-PRD-9aBc"]
routes:
  - path: "/v1/search"
    rate_windows:
      - name: novena-launch-search
        limit_rps: 600
        duration_seconds: 172800 # 48h
        fallback_rps: 150
  - path: "/v1/assist"
    rate_windows:
      - name: novena-launch-assist
        limit_rps: 300
        duration_seconds: 172800
        fallback_rps: 100
```
ivan_enginfra: I'll queue peering in sa-east-1 and put header enforcement on the proxy. Ops approval needed for sustained 600 rps. Any capacity ask?
tess_platform: Autoscaler should handle most, but recommend adding 2x warm workers (CPU-backed) for first 6h to absorb spikes while model cache ramps. I'll file a capacity ticket.
ops-oncall: Tentatively approve. Conditions: prewarm must be in place, alerting on p95>400ms or 5xx>1% will page. We'll also enable synthetic health checks hitting /v1/search every 2m.
leo_cs: Good. Two extra asks from AE: (1) schedule a 30-min launch-window warroom w/ Novena, AE, CS, Ops, Eng at T-1h; (2) link this to renewal note and highlight that successful launch mitigates churn risk.
ae_karen: Acknowledged. I'll add to renewal doc and schedule the warroom.
julia_novena: Thanks team. We'll do a staged cutover: route 10% traffic at T0, 50% at T+30m, 100% T+90m. We'll post any anomalies here.
ivan_enginfra: Action items saved and auto-revoke scheduled at T+48h for the rate windows. Scheduling: apply-header-rule and peering on 2026-04-02T13:00:00Z, revoke on 2026-04-04T13:00:00Z.
tess_platform: I'll publish dashboards: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, request rate per route, token cost per 1k tokens. Also set eval job to run a lightweight prompt set every 15m for first 24h to catch quality regressions.
leo_cs: Perfect. Julia please ping here during the first 12h post-cutover with top-level customer feedback. :thumbsup:
julia_novena: Will do. Thanks everyone.
